title: Samsung RF28 — Test mode entry
description: Fridge + FlexZone 6 s → FlexZone enters Test Mode (FF → OF r → rd → Fd).

steps.title: Enter test mode
steps.body: Press Fridge + FlexZone ≥6 s until display blinks 0.5 s. Release and press FlexZone to enter Test Mode.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press Fridge + FlexZone ≥6 s until display blinks 0.5 s. Release and press FlexZone to enter Test Mode.

steps.title: Test mode sequence
steps.body: Within 15 s press any key: FF (manual op 1) → OF r (manual op 2) → rd (R defrost) → Fd (F+R defrost) → cancel. Power cycle cancels.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Within 15 s press any key: FF (manual op 1) → OF r (manual op 2) → rd (R defrost) → Fd (F+R defrost) → cancel. Power cycle cancels.
